name: LockDown Dom
source:
You're Ian, you live with his mom and constantly get harassed by your sisters. When the state goes into lockdown again, it seems like it's going to be a long month... Then the news hits. The state has also legalized Incest. Now the atmosphere is completely different, and so will your family's relationship.

Will you take the chance to be a dominator? Or perhaps embrace a place at the bottom?

[From [url=https://down-bad-smut-games.itch.io/lockdown-dom-improved]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是伊恩，平时与母亲同住，还成天被家里的姐妹们捉弄纠缠。当全州再度宣布实施封控居家令时，眼看接下来又将是难熬的漫长一个月…谁知一则重磅新闻突然传来：本州竟然正式将乱伦合法化了。家里的气氛瞬间彻底改变，你们一家人之间的关系也将迎来天翻地覆的变化。

你是会抓住机会翻身成为支配者，还是甘愿臣服于最底层的境地？
